info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API provides users with the ability to retrieve the current status of their auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows consumers to track progress and updates regarding their submitted quotes, facilitating better decision-making and follow-up actions. Typical users include insurance agents, brokers, and customers seeking clarity on their quote submissions. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their customer service and streamline communication related to auto insurance inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to get the current status of the quotes in the system. It provides relevant information regarding each quote's progress and state, helping users track their quotes efficiently.
